Students must have completed at least one programming course (e.g., CSCI 1012 or equivalent) or have comparable experience working in at least one programming language. You do not need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable reading code, following the logic of a program, and recognizing when something is wrong — these are the skills that let you supervise an agent rather than blindly trust it. **Students with zero coding experience will find this course very difficult.**
